title: Digital Twin AI: Opportunities and Challenges from Large Language Models to World Models
summary: The abstract organizes AI-enabled twins into modeling, mirroring, intervention and autonomous management; it discusses physics-informed approaches and world models.

title: Grounding Time-Series Foundation Models in Digital Twin Topology for Predictive Maintenance
summary: The abstract describes topology-constrained fusion of time-series representations for predictive maintenance. Cross-channel information and target-task adaptation are investigated; benefits depend on the benchmark.

title: LSDTs: LLM-Augmented Semantic Digital Twins for Adaptive Knowledge-Intensive Infrastructure Planning
summary: The abstract describes extracting unstructured planning knowledge into an ontology and using a semantic layer for infrastructure planning.
